parameters.jsCode: const s=$json;const c=s.context&&typeof s.context==='object'?s.context:{};const sources=[['context.timeline_records',c.timeline_records],['context.timeline',c.timeline],['context.events',c.events],['timeline_records',s.timeline_records],['timeline',s.timeline],['events',s.events]];let records=[];let field='none';for(const [name,value] of sources){if(Array.isArray(value)){records=value;field=name;break;}}return[{json:{is_valid:s.is_valid===true,validation_errors:s.validation_errors??[],timeline_records:records,timeline_source_field:field,timeline_context:{canon_uuid:typeof c.canon_uuid==='string'?c.canon_uuid.trim():'',novel_uuid:typeof c.novel_uuid==='string'?c.novel_uuid.trim():'',workspace_uuid:typeof c.workspace_uuid==='string'?c.workspace_uuid.trim():'',chapter_uuid:typeof c.chapter_uuid==='string'?c.chapter_uuid.trim():'',chapter_number:c.chapter_number??0,chapter_title:typeof c.chapter_title==='string'?c.chapter_title.trim().replace(/\s+/gu,' '):''}}}];

const types=new Set(['battle','breakthrough','death','birth','marriage','betrayal','alliance','inheritance','mission','discovery','sect_event','kingdom_event','world_event','other']);const arrays=['participants','locations','factions','aliases'];const clean=v=>typeof v==='string'?v.trim().replace(/\s+/gu,' '):'';const normalized=$json.timeline_records.map((original_record,source_index)=>{const r=original_record&&typeof original_record==='object'&&!Array.isArray(original_record)?original_record:{};const array_types={};const values={};for(const field of arrays){array_types[field]=r[field]==null||Array.isArray(r[field]);const seen=new Set();values[field]=[];for(const value of Array.isArray(r[field])?r[field]:[]){const item=clean(value);if(item&&!seen.has(item)){seen.add(item);values[field].push(item);}}}const rawType=clean(r.event_type).toLowerCase();const chapterValid=r.chapter_number==null||(Number.isInteger(r.chapter_number)&&r.chapter_number>=0);const orderValid=r.event_order==null||(Number.isInteger(r.event_order)&&r.event_order>=0);return{source_index,original_record,array_types,chapter_type_valid:chapterValid,order_type_valid:orderValid,record:{event_name:clean(r.event_name),event_type:types.has(rawType)?rawType:'other',chapter_number:chapterValid&&r.chapter_number!=null?r.chapter_number:$json.timeline_context.chapter_number,event_order:orderValid&&r.event_order!=null?r.event_order:0,participants:values.participants,locations:values.locations,factions:values.factions,aliases:values.aliases,description:clean(r.description),notes:clean(r.notes),source_chapter_uuid:clean(r.source_chapter_uuid)||$json.timeline_context.chapter_uuid}}});return[{json:{...$json,normalized_timeline_records:normalized,supported_event_types:[...types]}}];

const valid=[];const invalid=[];for(const item of $json.normalized_timeline_records){const errors=[];const r=item.record;if(!r.event_name)errors.push('event_name is required.');if(!item.chapter_type_valid||!Number.isInteger(r.chapter_number)||r.chapter_number<0)errors.push('chapter_number must be a non-negative integer.');if(!item.order_type_valid||!Number.isInteger(r.event_order)||r.event_order<0)errors.push('event_order must be a non-negative integer.');for(const field of ['participants','locations','factions','aliases'])if(!item.array_types[field]||!Array.isArray(r[field]))errors.push(`${field} must be an array.`);if(errors.length)invalid.push({source_index:item.source_index,validation_errors:errors,original_record:item.original_record});else valid.push({...r,source_index:item.source_index});}return[{json:{...$json,valid_timeline_records:valid,invalid_timeline_records:invalid}}];

const arrays=['aliases','participants','locations','factions'];const scalars=['event_type','event_order','description','notes','source_chapter_uuid'];const empty=v=>v===''||v===null||v===undefined;const map=new Map();const conflicts=[];let duplicates=0;for(const incoming of $json.timeline_objects){const key=`${incoming.event_name.toLocaleLowerCase()}::${incoming.chapter_number}`;if(!map.has(key)){const base={...incoming};for(const field of arrays)base[field]=[...incoming[field]];map.set(key,base);continue;}duplicates++;const existing=map.get(key);for(const field of arrays)existing[field]=[...new Set([...existing[field],...incoming[field]])];for(const field of scalars){if(empty(existing[field])&&!empty(incoming[field]))existing[field]=incoming[field];else if(!empty(existing[field])&&!empty(incoming[field])&&existing[field]!==incoming[field])conflicts.push({event_name:existing.event_name,chapter_number:existing.chapter_number,field,existing_value:existing[field],incoming_value:incoming[field],source_index:incoming._source_index});}}const timeline=[...map.values()].map(({_source_index,...event})=>event);return[{json:{...$json,timeline,timeline_conflicts:conflicts,duplicates_merged:duplicates}}];

## Timeline Intake
Validate WF-008 and select an explicit event array.

## Timeline Normalization
Normalize supplied events without prose parsing or inference.

## Timeline Knowledge Objects
Generate TML identities and versioned provenance.

## Deduplication
Merge by event name + chapter number and report conflicts.

## Output
Calculate summary and emit the WF-010 contract.
